column3: “clear oil from beaten olives” renders “pure pressed olive oil,” and “to make a lamp burn” renders “to lift up a lamp.”
“the veil of testimony” renders “the curtain (parokhet) of the testimony,” and “keep it in order” renders “arrange it.”
NASB supplies “gold” in “the pure gold lampstand.”
“cakes” renders “hallot,” ring-shaped loaves, and NASB supplies “of an ephah.”
NASB supplies “gold” in “the pure gold table.”
“Every sabbath day” renders “on the sabbath day, on the sabbath day.”
“most holy” renders “a holy of holies,” and “his portion forever” renders “a prescribed portion of perpetuity.”
“blasphemed” renders a verb that can mean “pierced” or “pronounced” (also in verse 16); NASB puts the note on his mother in parentheses.
“so that the command of the LORD might be made clear to them” renders “to make it clear to them at the mouth of the LORD.”
“shall surely be put to death” and “shall certainly stone” render emphatic doubled verbs.
“takes the life of any human being” renders “strikes any soul (nefesh) of adam.”
